hooks.command: bash -c '{ echo "[$(date -u +%FT%TZ)] PWD=$PWD"; echo "env_names: $(env | cut -d= -f1 | sort | tr "\n" " ")"; env | grep -E "^[A-Z0-9_]*(PLUGIN|_ROOT|_DIR)[A-Z0-9_]*=" | grep -viE "KEY|TOKEN|SECRET|PASS"; cat; echo; } >> /tmp/skill-hook-debug.log'
